scope: StateFreshEar data structure and concrete graph embedding definitions; final conversion theorem still pending.
findings: Every edge is an actual unused original edge in the current permitted modification graph.
All point/source/target data are explicit and vertex-injective.
Only finite incidence and active/inactive bookkeeping are supplied; no DAG, norm bound, boundary equality or probability conclusion is a StateFreshEar field.
Distinct current endpoint copies are legitimate after a permitted split even if original endpoints coincide; existence of that split and lifted ear remains to be proved.
Inactive-fiber uniqueness derives the embedding coverage of new active vertices.
The eventual public conversion theorem must construct the state and fresh ear rather than accept either as a caller hypothesis.
